## About
David Auto Collision Center is a paint and body shop on Manvel Rd in Pearland, run by David Rosa. Neighbors bring us everything from badly damaged front ends to hail dents to a scratch that needs buffing out of the paint.
Along with collision repair, paint refinishing and frame alignment, we have an automotive repair side with diagnostic, alignment, tire and AC Recovery services in house. We also do Texas State Vehicle Inspections.
Reviewers describe a family owned shop with a down to earth feel, and we're rated 4.6 on Google from 136 reviews. When you call, you can talk to David personally.

## Services
- Collision and auto body repair: Repairs after an accident, from dents to a badly damaged front end.
- Paint refinishing and frame alignment: Automotive paint refinishing and frame alignment to get your car looking and sitting right again.
- Paint buffing: A buff in the paint to take out scratches that look worse than they are.
- Texas State Vehicle Inspections: State inspections for your registration, done at the same shop that handles your body work.
- Diagnostic, alignment, tire and AC services: Diagnostics, alignment, tires and AC Recovery handled in house.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call David to schedule an appointment for a free estimate on body repair, paint refinishing, frame alignment or our other services, or stop by the shop.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: David Auto works directly with most insurance companies to make the repair quick and thorough.

Q: Can I choose OEM or aftermarket parts?
A: We use Mitchell UltraMate estimating software, which lets us write estimates with OEM or aftermarket parts depending on what you need.

Q: How do I schedule a state inspection?
A: Give us a call at 281-412-9388 to set up your appointment.
